definition.description: From a clear, level walking lane, take a controlled forward step and organize on one stance leg. Bring the ipsilateral knee toward the chest with light hand assistance only to the available comfortable range; keep the trunk and pelvis organized, release the leg, and step through before repeating on the other side. One cycle is one left and one right controlled knee-hug step-through. Record sides, cycles, range, hold, pace, support use, lane, symptoms, and substitutions. This is not a stationary knee hug, calf raise, quad pull, high-knee march, lunge, hop, test, or run.
